climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Merlot sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Romanian PDO in Mehedinţi, where Merlot (6 percent) leads plantings, ahead of Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc (4 each). Its rules allow Negru de Drăgăşani, Novac, Tămâioasă Românească, Pinot Noir and Syrah, among others.
